native_mechanisms: Servant's inflated-house swats enforce silence so the marks' given order is fixed/committed before any heap is folded

Each heap races the musk deer's mountain stride — uphill twist, downhill fold, a doubling-back that eats its own trail — so no heap keeps the shape it entered with, the running shape carried into the next heap
The owl seals the final folded shape to one fixed token size while every intermediate heap is burned, making the token one-way and unwalkable back to its marks
core_technique: xxHash3-style hashing: 8×64-bit accumulator lanes over 64-byte stripes with 32×32→64 multiply-accumulate plus lane-swapped (acc[j^1]) data addition, a periodic xor-shift/xor-secret/multiply scramble every 16 stripes, length-seeded short-input regimes, and a 128-bit fold plus moremur xor-shift-multiply finalizer.
